summary: Seven-phase, 7.5-hour plan across six dependency waves. Phase 1 verifies live topology and creates an isolated worktree from origin/feat/propositional-v2; Phases 2 and 3 run in parallel (rebase + conflict resolution, toolchain/Mathlib warm-up); Phase 4 reconciles Defs.lean to the research 4.3 target on upstream's Operators.lean typeclasses; Phase 5 verifies the two NaturalDeduction files; Phase 6 greens the five upstream CI gates and re-gates the four-file scope; Phase 7 emits factual PR scaffolding and stops at a local commit. No push, no gh write, no Zulip post at any phase.
decisions_made: Work happens in a dedicated git worktree created from origin/feat/propositional-v2, never by checking that branch out in the main tree: specs/ and .claude/ are fork-only and an in-place checkout would delete them. This also makes the 'fork main is never a merge/cherry-pick/resolution source' constraint structural.

Toolchain and Mathlib cache warm-up (Phase 3) is a separate phase running parallel to the rebase (Phase 2), since the rebase inherits upstream's v4.33.0 / db584cd6 pins with zero conflict and v4.33.0 is not currently installed locally.

Verified against upstream/main's lean_action_ci.yml: the PR CI is exactly five gates (build --wfail --iofail, test --wfail --iofail, mk_all --check, checkInitImports, lint-style). lake shake is commented out. This fork's sorry-suppression and axiom-census ratchet steps are fork-local and are NOT PR gates.
Phase 6 carries a hard scope gate: git diff --stat against the new merge base must name exactly the four approved files; a fifth file halts the phase rather than being absorbed.

Phase 7 produces specs/620_rebase_pr648_clear_review/pr-scaffolding.md as verified fact tables with an explicit 'not prose to paste' header; the PR description update and re-review request stay user actions per pr-prohibition.md.
task_type is cslib, so [PR READY] is unavailable (type=pr only); the plan terminates at [COMPLETED] with a completion summary stating the branch is local and unpushed.
dead_ends: In-place git checkout of feat/propositional-v2 in the main working tree: upstream has no specs/ or .claude/, so the checkout would delete the task-management artifacts or refuse on local modifications.

Introducing HasBot/HasTop typeclasses: neither exists upstream (Operators.lean provides HasAnd/HasOr/HasImp/HasIff/HasNot/HasBox/HasDiamond/HasDynamicBox/HasDynamicDiamond/HasTensor); Mathlib Bot/Top cover bottom/top. The agent context file listing HasBot/HasTop/HasDia is wrong.
Re-declaring local scoped notation in Defs.lean: the PR's five declarations must be deleted, not kept alongside upstream's Cslib.Logic scoped notation, which would create genuine ambiguity.
Reordering the Proposition constructors to reduce diff noise: churns match arms in subst/weak/subs/substAtom across two files that otherwise apply untouched.
